name: Daring Thief — Permanent B must share a card type with A; a pair that does not exchanges nothing
notes: "Inspired — Whenever this creature becomes untapped, you may exchange control of target nonland permanent you control and target permanent an opponent controls that shares a card type with it." (2026-10-18, with Spawnbroker.) The parser only read "share a card type", so "shares" set no rule. With Hill Giant as A, B lists only the opponent's Grizzly Bears (not their Island or Glorious Anthem), and the pair Hill Giant / Glorious Anthem set anyway is refused by the engine.

scryfallData.name: Hill Giant
scryfallData.flavor_text: Fortunately, hill giants have large blind spots in which a human can easily hide. Unfortunately, these blind spots are beneath the bottoms of their feet.

scryfallData.name: Grizzly Bears
scryfallData.flavor_text:

—Jolrael, empress of beasts

scryfallData.name: Glorious Anthem
